saints.name: St. Barnabas
saints.title: Apostle
saints.shortBlurb: The “son of encouragement,” a Levite of Cyprus who vouched for Paul and carried the Gospel to the Gentiles…
biography: Barnabas, a Levite of Cyprus, sold his land for the early community and was the one who brought the newly converted Paul to the Apostles when others feared him. Sent to Antioch, he fetched Paul to help him, and the two were set apart for the first missionary journey; though not one of the Twelve, he is called an Apostle.
Tradition holds that he preached in Cyprus and was there martyred.
saints.knownFor: Encouraging the young Church and befriending St. Paul.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 11 June
